idea-plugin.name: QueryDesk
idea-plugin.description:
Connect DataGrip, and any JetBrains IDE with the Database tools, to the databases you reach through QueryDesk.

Every query runs in QueryDesk as you, with your access, reviews, data protection and the audit log applied, so the IDE never holds a database password.

  • Connect QueryDesk in the Database Explorer's + menu signs you in in the browser and adds a data source for each database credential you can use, grouped by QueryDesk group. Each loads its schema the first time you open it.
  • Stays signed in across restarts: the refresh token is kept in the IDE's password safe.
  • PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle and ClickHouse.

Source: github.com/devhub-tools/querydesk-datagrip

action.description: Sign in to QueryDesk and add a data source for each database you can use
